init.text: Web developer specialized in creating modern and efficient experiences.

about.title: About
about.description1: My name is Jefferson Santos, a Full-Stack Developer with 4 years of experience and a technical degree in Systems Development. I currently work at a software house focused on retail automation, where I have built more than 3 projects from scratch, handling both back-end and front-end — systems that are in use by clients today. I write code with quality and longevity in mind, not just to make it work.
about.description2: Outside of work, my priorities are clear: my life with God, my family, my hobbies, my studies and working on my own ventures. I play a few instruments, enjoy reading about faith, personal growth, finance and technology, and I keep studying to grow as a developer and as a person.

skills.title: Skills
skills.defaultText: * Hover over skills to learn more *
skills.textNodejs: I chose Node.js because it allows me to create scalable and fast applications that can handle many requests at the same time without losing performance. I enjoy exploring the power of JavaScript on the backend and its frameworks to develop modern, solid solutions that truly make a difference.
skills.textExpress: Express.js is my go-to framework for creating robust and scalable RESTful APIs, providing a flexible and modular structure to handle requests and responses efficiently.
skills.textNestjs: I am passionate about learning and mastering Nest.js, a framework that promises to revolutionize the way I develop robust and scalable server-side applications, with a modular architecture and integration with TypeScript.
skills.textReact: With the powerful React library, I develop dynamic and reactive interfaces, creating fluid and interactive user experiences with JavaScript and TypeScript, always prioritizing performance and scalability.
skills.textNextJs: With Next.js, I create truly exceptional server-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation (SSG) web applications, ensuring impeccable speed, SEO, and user experience.
skills.textSass: Sass is my tool of choice for creating more efficient and modular CSS styles, leveraging the ability to use variables, mixins, and functions to create a personalized and responsive user experience.
skills.textFlutter: Currently, I study and apply Flutter in the development of cross-platform mobile applications, creating personalized interfaces and high-quality, fluid user experiences.
skills.textJava: Java is my first love; with it, I create 'Topzadas' applications that meet the most complex needs, leveraging the ability to handle large volumes of data and ensure data integrity and availability.
skills.textPostgres: Postgres is my database of choice, and with Neon, I can efficiently provision and manage serverless databases, ensuring data integrity and availability.
skills.textMySQL: With MySQL, I store and manage large volumes of data efficiently and scalably, ensuring data integrity and availability.
skills.textGit: Git and GitHub are my go-to tools for managing code versioning and collaborating with other developers, ensuring code integrity and traceability.
skills.textDocker: With Docker, I can containerize applications and ensure consistency and portability across different environments, simplifying the development, testing, and deployment process, and ensuring scalability and reliability.
skills.textTypescript: TypeScript is the standard in my current projects — front end, back end and mobile. Typing lets me refactor large systems like Vendaí and Simbora Gerir without breaking what already works.
skills.textReactNative: With React Native and Expo I build Android and iOS apps from a single codebase: Propfy, Verbum, JeffPay and JTEC's leads app, using Expo Router, local SQLite and notifications.
skills.textPrisma: Prisma is the ORM I use in most of my PostgreSQL APIs. Clear modeling, versioned migrations and typed queries in projects like Cobraaí, CifreAqui and my payment system.
skills.textRedis: I use Redis for caching, queues and concurrency control: with BullMQ I run background jobs (PDFs, billing, notifications) in Vendaí, Simbora Gerir and Cobraaí.
skills.textTauri: With Tauri I turn web applications into lightweight desktop apps for Windows, Linux and macOS — like my pomodoro app, CifreAqui and FreelanceCalc.
skills.textJest: I write automated tests with Jest and Supertest to make sure my APIs' business rules and endpoints keep working with every change.

privacy.intro: This website is maintained by {{name}}, the controller of the personal data processed here under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law 13,709/2018).
privacy.consentPrefix: I have read and agree to the
privacy.consentSuffix: . My data will only be used to reply to this message.

data.title: What we collect
data.text: Only what you type in the contact form: name, email, subject and message. The site uses no tracking cookies, ads or visitor analytics.

purpose.title: Why we use it
purpose.text: Solely to reply to your message and, if applicable, to discuss a project or service proposal.

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.text: Processing happens at your request, as preliminary steps toward a possible contract (LGPD, art. 7, V), and with your express consent when you submit the form (Brazilian Internet Civil Framework, art. 7, IX).

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.text: Your message is delivered by email through EmailJS and arrives in the owner's Gmail inbox. The site also loads fonts from Google Fonts and an image hosted on GitHub, which receive your browser's IP address when serving those files. These services may store data outside Brazil (LGPD, art. 33). Your data is never sold or used for other purposes.

retention.title: How long
retention.text: Messages are kept only as long as needed to handle your request and are deleted whenever you ask.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: At any time you may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, portability or deletion of your data, information about sharing, and withdrawal of consent (LGPD, art. 18). Just send an email to the address below.

storage.title: Browser storage
storage.text: The site stores only your chosen language and theme in your own browser (localStorage). This information never leaves your device.

claudeSkill.subtitle: my AI pair
claudeSkill.short: I use it every day to code, automate and create content. See where AI fits into my workflow.
claudeSkill.title: How I work with Claude
claudeSkill.intro: Claude is my development partner. I define what needs to be done, the architecture and the quality bar; it speeds up execution and handles the repetitive checks. Everything goes through my review before it reaches a client.

code.title: Code and projects
code.text: I build and refactor websites, React Native apps and APIs with Claude, including in the style of my own backend framework. It writes, tests and commits straight to GitHub; I own the architecture and the review.

quality.title: Quality and compliance
quality.text: I have my own skills that run on every website: technical SEO (meta tags, sitemap, structured data), checks against the applicable Brazilian laws such as LGPD and e-commerce rules, plus design and accessibility review.

deploy.title: Deploys and automation
deploy.text: I set up automatic deploys with GitHub Actions, generate project screenshots and images, organize repositories and automate repetitive tasks that used to take hours.

content.title: Content and marketing
content.text: Scripts, Reels, creatives and product videos made in code, plus copy for LinkedIn, sales pages and social media.

claudeSkill.foot: The result: I ship faster without lowering quality, and I bring this same way of working to my clients' projects.
